technicalBasis.heading: Distinguish recovery from validated data availability.
technicalBasis.body: Data recovery describes retrieved records; validated data availability describes records retained after agreed quality checks. Define the denominator, recording interval, exclusions and quality flags when reporting either metric. Retain raw data, traceable corrections, calibration and maintenance records, timestamp conventions and uncertainty information. The profile-reported recovery above 95% is historical experience, not a guaranteed validated availability for every channel or campaign.

technicalBasis.heading: Resource measurements and PV monitoring serve different purposes.
technicalBasis.body: For resource assessment, define global horizontal irradiance (GHI), direct normal irradiance (DNI) and diffuse horizontal irradiance (DHI) as required by the project. ISO 9060:2018 describes classification and specifications for relevant solar-radiation instruments. IEC 61724-1:2021 addresses PV-system performance monitoring; it is not a blanket certification for a pre-development solar resource campaign. Agree sensor calibration, siting, cleaning, acquisition and QA/QC requirements for the intended use.
